profiles.name: hi-accessibility-review
profiles.purpose: Check user-interface changes for material accessibility regressions.
profiles.trigger: UI behavior or markup changed and accessibility can be affected.
profiles.do_not_trigger: No user-facing UI surface changed.
profiles.exit_condition: Accessibility risks are checked and actionable findings are resolved or recorded.

profiles.name: hi-adversarial-validation
profiles.purpose: Run a bounded disproof-oriented challenge for high-stakes claims or decisions.
profiles.trigger: Critical, security-sensitive, irreversible, or cross-boundary claim needs independent challenge.
profiles.do_not_trigger: Mechanical or low-risk work with direct evidence.
profiles.exit_condition: Material assumptions are challenged and findings are reconciled without an open blocking issue.

profiles.name: hi-api-contract-review
profiles.purpose: Review changed APIs, events, schemas, and compatibility contracts.
profiles.trigger: An implemented contract boundary changed.
profiles.do_not_trigger: No externally or cross-module observable contract changed.
profiles.exit_condition: Consumers, errors, compatibility, serialization, and contract tests are reconciled.

profiles.name: hi-api-interface-design
profiles.purpose: Design a stable interface from consumer requirements and compatibility constraints.
profiles.trigger: A public/internal API, event, schema, command, or durable boundary is being created or materially changed.
profiles.do_not_trigger: Pure implementation detail with no boundary consequence.
profiles.exit_condition: Inputs, outputs, errors, side effects, compatibility, and acceptance tests are explicit.

profiles.name: hi-architecture-decisions
profiles.purpose: Record durable architecture choices with evidence and consequences.
profiles.trigger: A durable choice has credible alternatives and future maintenance consequences.
profiles.do_not_trigger: Local/reversible implementation choice does not need durable rationale.
profiles.exit_condition: Decision, credible alternatives, consequences, and evidence are recorded in the project convention.

profiles.name: hi-browser-testing
profiles.purpose: Perform targeted browser validation using an authorized browser capability.
profiles.trigger: Changed behavior requires real browser interaction or rendering evidence.
profiles.do_not_trigger: No browser surface is involved or browser tooling is unavailable.
profiles.exit_condition: Target routes/interactions are exercised and relevant console/network/visual evidence is captured.

profiles.name: hi-changelog-and-documentation
profiles.purpose: Update user-facing documentation for observable behavior changes.
profiles.trigger: A verified change affects users, installation, configuration, API, security, or supported behavior, or documentation/changelog alignment is explicitly requested.
profiles.do_not_trigger: Internal refactor/cosmetic rename with no user-visible effect.
profiles.exit_condition: Canonical English documentation matches implemented behavior and translation does not add behavior.

profiles.name: hi-ci-build-recovery
profiles.purpose: Isolate the first real CI/build failure and repair its root cause.
profiles.trigger: Build or CI fails or differs materially from local execution.
profiles.do_not_trigger: No build/CI failure exists.
profiles.exit_condition: Failure class and root cause are identified, repaired when authorized, and the affected pipeline evidence is green or externally blocked.

profiles.name: hi-code-review
profiles.purpose: Independently review meaningful diffs against intent, behavior, risk, and tests.
profiles.trigger: A non-trivial code diff merits independent review.
profiles.do_not_trigger: Tiny mechanical low-risk edits with direct targeted verification.
profiles.exit_condition: Actionable findings are resolved/rejected with evidence and scoped re-review closes prior findings.

profiles.name: hi-database-migration
profiles.purpose: Plan and validate safe schema/data migrations and transitional compatibility.
profiles.trigger: Schema, migration, backfill, or persistent data compatibility changes.
profiles.do_not_trigger: No persistent schema/data transition.
profiles.exit_condition: Ordering, compatibility, rollback, locking/volume risk, and migration evidence are sufficient.

profiles.name: hi-debugging-root-cause
profiles.purpose: Turn a symptom into evidence-backed root cause through discriminating experiments.
profiles.trigger: Failure cause is uncertain, repeated, or crosses boundaries.
profiles.do_not_trigger: Cause is already direct and proven by local evidence.
profiles.exit_condition: Root cause is demonstrated or a precise external blocker is established; retries are materially different.

profiles.name: hi-dependency-change
profiles.purpose: Evaluate and verify dependency/lockfile changes for necessity, compatibility, and security.
profiles.trigger: A dependency or lockfile must be added, removed, or upgraded.
profiles.do_not_trigger: No dependency surface changes.
profiles.exit_condition: Need, version/lock impact, compatibility, and appropriate verification are established.

profiles.name: hi-design-discovery
profiles.purpose: Resolve material product/architecture ambiguity before expensive implementation.
profiles.trigger: Multiple materially different designs remain after repository evidence is considered.
profiles.do_not_trigger: Clear, low-risk, reversible implementation path exists.
profiles.exit_condition: Material ambiguity is resolved into explicit constraints without unnecessary approval ceremony.

profiles.name: hi-implementation-planning
profiles.purpose: Create the minimum dependency-oriented plan required for coordinated changes.
profiles.trigger: Cross-module sequencing, migration, rollback, or coupled acceptance requires coordination.
profiles.do_not_trigger: Clear local task can be executed directly.
profiles.exit_condition: Dependencies, ordered changes, acceptance, verification, and rollback needs are explicit enough to execute.

profiles.name: hi-iterative-retrieval
profiles.purpose: Grow repository context only when current evidence creates a concrete information need.
profiles.trigger: Relevant symbols/paths are not known and bounded retrieval can reduce uncertainty.
profiles.do_not_trigger: Required context is already known and fresh.
profiles.exit_condition: Task can execute or blocker is precise without further context expansion.

profiles.name: hi-performance-analysis
profiles.purpose: Analyze measurable performance behavior and compare changes on the same workload.
profiles.trigger: There is a performance target/regression or hot-path claim requiring evidence.
profiles.do_not_trigger: No measurable performance concern exists.
profiles.exit_condition: Relevant baseline and after measurements support the conclusion without correctness regression.

profiles.name: hi-regression-review
profiles.purpose: Check likely neighboring behavior affected by a changed contract or shared component.
profiles.trigger: A change can plausibly affect existing consumers/shared behavior, or regression-focused review is explicitly requested.
profiles.do_not_trigger: Change is isolated with no dependent behavior.
profiles.exit_condition: Likely regressions are covered by existing or targeted tests; scope does not expand speculatively.

profiles.name: hi-release-guardrails
profiles.purpose: Verify release metadata, package integrity, evidence, and authority boundaries.
profiles.trigger: A release candidate, package, tag, publish, or distribution step is being prepared.
profiles.do_not_trigger: Ordinary development not approaching a release boundary.
profiles.exit_condition: Candidate evidence is exact-bound and external publication remains explicitly authorized.

profiles.name: hi-repository-analysis
profiles.purpose: Map the minimum relevant files, symbols, dependencies, tests, and configuration.
profiles.trigger: Task scope or ownership is unclear enough that repository inspection will change execution.
profiles.do_not_trigger: Known local scope already has fresh evidence.
profiles.exit_condition: Relevant ownership and affected surface are known with remaining uncertainty explicit.

profiles.name: hi-review-feedback
profiles.purpose: Validate review findings against current code and apply only evidence-backed corrections.
profiles.trigger: Review/QA/security feedback proposes changes.
profiles.do_not_trigger: No external review findings need reconciliation.
profiles.exit_condition: Each finding is classified and actionable ones are fixed and scoped-verified.

profiles.name: hi-safe-refactoring
profiles.purpose: Preserve behavior while making bounded structural changes.
profiles.trigger: Refactor is explicitly requested or needed to enable a required change.
profiles.do_not_trigger: Behavior change is the primary task and no structural refactor is required.
profiles.exit_condition: Pre/post behavior evidence is equivalent and public contracts remain stable unless explicitly changed.

profiles.name: hi-security-review
profiles.purpose: Review authority, secrets, trust boundaries, input handling, and attack surface proportionally.
profiles.trigger: Security-sensitive code, permissions, credentials, external actions, or trust boundaries changed.
profiles.do_not_trigger: No material security surface changed.
profiles.exit_condition: Material threats are addressed or explicitly accepted with evidence; secrets are not exposed.

profiles.name: hi-methodology-authoring
profiles.purpose: Create or evolve reusable Hi methodologies from explicit demand or repeated project evidence.
profiles.trigger: A reusable way of working is explicitly requested or repeated project evidence shows a methodology gap.
profiles.do_not_trigger: One-off facts/evidence, project knowledge, control-plane policy, or an existing methodology already covers the need.
profiles.exit_condition: Methodology contract, role compatibility, admission policy, provenance, resources, and validation are coherent and non-duplicative.

profiles.name: hi-source-driven-development
profiles.purpose: Inspect authoritative source before adapting an external implementation or methodology.
profiles.trigger: External repository/specification/implementation is material to the requested change.
profiles.do_not_trigger: Task is fully internal and no external implementation evidence is relevant.
profiles.exit_condition: Source, license, primitive, ownership, reuse action, and test strategy are recorded before reuse.

profiles.name: hi-test-driven-development
profiles.purpose: Use a failing test first when behavior can be specified economically before implementation.
profiles.trigger: New/changed behavior benefits from executable specification and a tight red-green-refactor loop.
profiles.do_not_trigger: Pure documentation, exploratory diagnosis, or test-first cost exceeds value.
profiles.exit_condition: Behavior is implemented with focused tests and no unnecessary test ceremony.

profiles.name: hi-test-strategy
profiles.purpose: Choose risk-proportional verification at the narrowest sufficient boundaries.
profiles.trigger: Implementation changes require deciding what evidence is sufficient.
profiles.do_not_trigger: No behavior changed or verification policy is already explicit and fresh.
profiles.exit_condition: Required targeted/dependency/integration evidence is defined and executed without verification spiral.

profiles.name: hi-visual-qa
profiles.purpose: Validate changed visual output for layout, clipping, state, and responsive regressions.
profiles.trigger: Visual UI rendering/styling changed materially, or visual QA is explicitly requested.
profiles.do_not_trigger: No visual surface changed.
profiles.exit_condition: Relevant viewports/states are checked and visual defects are resolved or recorded.

policy.project_admission: native SKILL.md + Hi policy sidecar + Hi provenance sidecar
